name: Wulingyuan Scenic and Historic Interest Area
description: In China's Hunan Province, Wulingyuan is a maze of more than 3,000 slender sandstone pillars, many taller than 200 metres, rising from forested valleys. Streams, pools and waterfalls wind through the gorges below, and about 40 caves hide among the peaks. Look for Tianqiaoshengkong, "bridge across the sky", one of the world's highest natural bridges. Rare animals such as the Asiatic black bear live here too.
